page.overview:
What is Moth into Flame?

Moth into Flame is the fourth song off of Metallica's tenth studio album Hardwired...to Self-Destruct.

It is also the second single from the album. The song was written and composed by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich. The song is a more groove orientated based song, as opposed to Hardwired being more thrash.

The song is about fame and celebrities, inspired by the way so many people in modern society live every day striving to be loved.

Blacked out Pop queen, amphetamine The screams crashed into silence
